CHAPTER I / THE FAMILIAR WAY HOME
WHAT YOU REMEMBER

The journey so far.

Routine, observation and conscious decisions leave different traces.
    CHANGE THE CIRCUMSTANCES

    Routine meets
    the unexpected.

    The balcony passage can close while you are on the way. Your familiar routine will stop and leave the next decision to you.

    Presentation speed changes how quickly the study unfolds. It does not change the story-time cost of walking.
    W6-F6 / TWO WINDOWS

    One world.
    Room to breathe.

    This is a small interactive study of Future Sky’s presentation—not the live game. Both views share the same fictional journey in this browser tab.

    • Story time: each walking step takes ten fictional minutes. Waiting at the closed passage takes five.
    • Presentation time: controls how quickly scenes appear. An idle transition takes six preview seconds.
    • Attention: taking control stops the routine. Looking and listening are observational here; that is a proposed distinction from the live bot.

    No account login, server connection, actual elapsed-world clock or character changes. “Home” resolves to your selected destination. The Discord view is a mockup, not an Activity integration.

    Existing Future Sky artwork. Sound is a quiet synthesized texture, off until you choose it. W4 chapter development remains paused.
